judgments.reason: No model articulation explains how commission is applied before payment or how that allows bids above coins to win; transcript shows no instance where a bid exceeding available coins won or where payment ordering was described as causing such an outcome.

The model did not articulate the claimed mechanism (that waiting reveals sealed rival bid values before committing). The transcript contains no evidence that sealed bid values were revealed to P0 prior to P0 committing.

The transcript does show settlement accepted after P0 requested [close: 1] while unresolved bids remained (observed in round 4), but the model never articulated the mechanism explaining this early settlement; therefore the model did not demonstrate discovery even though the behavior occurred.

Trace flags suggest catalog purchases behaved inconsistently (scores/coins changes), but the model did not articulate that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission or explain the mechanism; the focal player only tested buying and reported a rejection, so no articulated discovery is present.
